subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should unconfigured or implicit Codex/provider failures be silently discarded, or surfaced as generic provider-failure copy after raw payload suppression?
rationale: The parser gap is source-reproducible, but silent discard changes user-visible diagnostics and provider-routing behavior for OpenAI/Codex auto-mode.

options.title: Parser plus routing policy
options.body: Recognize top-level `detail` payloads and add tested routing behavior so unconfigured-provider errors never reach chat while diagnostics remain internal.

options.title: Parser-only repair
options.body: Land the narrow `detail` parser/test fix now and track unconfigured-provider suppression as a separate policy issue.

options.title: Keep generic failures
options.body: Keep generic user-facing provider failures and decline silent discard unless a maintainer confirms that these errors should be invisible.

recommendation.title: Parser plus routing policy
recommendation.body: Recognize top-level `detail` payloads and add tested routing behavior so unconfigured-provider errors never reach chat while diagnostics remain internal.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history signal for adjacent provider-error policy and current OpenAI/Codex routing work.
